tagline: Sync Microsoft Teams meetings to Google Calendar so your schedule is always complete
metaTitle: Google Calendar Microsoft Teams Integration: One Agenda
metaDescription: Sync Teams meeting invites to Google Calendar and create Teams meetings from calendar events. GAIA flags duplicate events. See the setup steps.
intro:
Many organizations operate across both Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, with some teams using Google Calendar while others schedule via Microsoft Teams. The result is a fragmented scheduling landscape: invites created in one tool don't show up in the other. Employees who work across both ecosystems maintain two separate calendars, miss cross-platform invites, and lose visibility into their full schedule.

GAIA bridges both so that every meeting appears in a single unified view. Teams meeting invites sync to Google Calendar with the meeting link intact. Calendar events can also generate meeting links automatically so organizers don't need to manage both tools. Availability blocks in one calendar are respected in the other so scheduling conflicts across platforms are eliminated.

This integration is essential for hybrid organizations using both Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, for consultants and contractors who work across client environments using different calendar systems, and for enterprise teams undergoing a migration between platforms who need both systems to operate together during the transition.

useCases.title: Sync Teams meeting invites to Google Calendar
useCases.description: GAIA automatically imports meeting invites into the calendar with the meeting join link, attendee list, and agenda so it shows your complete schedule including all the imported meetings.

useCases.title: Create Teams meetings from calendar events
useCases.description: When you add a meeting to the calendar, GAIA can generate a Microsoft Teams meeting link and add it to the event description, so attendees who work primarily in that tool receive a proper invite.

useCases.title: Keep availability consistent across both platforms
useCases.description: GAIA ensures that busy blocks in either calendar appear in the other, so your availability is always accurate regardless of which scheduling tool a meeting organizer uses.

useCases.title: Unified daily agenda across both calendars
useCases.description: Each morning GAIA delivers a consolidated daily agenda that merges your calendar events and meetings from both tools into a single ordered list, so you always know your full schedule without checking two platforms.

useCases.title: Meeting recording links in Google Calendar
useCases.description: After an online meeting ends, GAIA updates the corresponding calendar event with the recording link so participants who use the calendar can access the recording directly from their event.

howItWorks.step: Connect Google Calendar and Microsoft Teams to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize Google Calendar via Google OAuth and Microsoft Teams via Microsoft OAuth in GAIA's integration settings. GAIA accesses your calendar data and meeting schedule with read and limited write permissions.

howItWorks.step: Configure sync direction and meeting creation preferences
howItWorks.description: Choose whether sync is bidirectional or one-way, which event types generate online meetings from calendar events, and how far in advance future events should be imported.

howItWorks.step: GAIA maintains a unified schedule across both platforms
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both calendars for new and updated events and propagates changes in near real-time, ensuring your schedule is always complete and consistent in whichever calendar tool you prefer.

faqs.question: Will GAIA duplicate events that are already in both calendars?
faqs.answer: GAIA uses meeting ID and attendee matching to detect events that already exist in both calendars before creating a sync copy. Detected duplicates are flagged for review rather than blindly duplicated.

faqs.question: Can GAIA handle recurring Teams meetings synced to Google Calendar?
faqs.answer: Yes. Recurring meeting series are imported as recurring calendar events. When the series is updated or cancelled, GAIA updates the entire series in the calendar accordingly.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work if my organization uses both Google Workspace and Microsoft 365?
faqs.answer: Yes. This is the primary use case GAIA is designed for. GAIA acts as the neutral bridge between both platforms without requiring IT-level federation or directory sync between your Google and Microsoft tenants.
